paragraphs: As a web design agency in Wetzlar, we develop professional websites that actually win more clients – they don't just look good. Whether you're a trade business, medical practice, restaurant or local service provider, we understand the requirements of regional businesses in Wetzlar, Gießen, Marburg and throughout Central Hesse. Our websites are built with cutting-edge technologies like React and Next.js and load in under one second.

What sets us apart from other web design agencies: At Coday, you work directly with the developer, not a middleman. You get fixed pricing from €2,000 – no hidden costs, no hourly billing. And the entire code belongs to you: no vendor lock-in, no monthly license fees, no dependency on page builders like WordPress or Wix.

Our clients – including Batherm Sanitär & Heizung, Schlüsseldienst Wetzlar and Lindener Ratsstuben – confirm: since their relaunch, they receive significantly more local enquiries via Google. This is thanks to our combination of technical performance (load time under 1 second, perfect Core Web Vitals) and thoughtful local search engine optimization. We optimize your website for exactly the search terms your customers use to find your services.

Want to find out whether a new website makes sense for your business in Wetzlar or Central Hesse? Book a free initial consultation – personal, non-binding and without sales pressure. In 30 minutes, we'll show you where your current website is leaving potential on the table and how a modern, fast website can concretely bring you more clients.
